patterns.note: Sections are dominated by full-bleed imagery or video, often with minimal text overlays or adjacent to very sparse, understated text blocks.
Text is extremely minimal, predominantly small and uppercase for labels and navigation, contrasting with occasional very large, bold single-character display elements (e.g., the 'R' in the footer).
A stark monochrome palette of white and black is used for UI elements and text, with visual interest primarily derived from the rich, natural tones within the full-bleed photography and video.
Content sections reveal by smoothly sliding up and subtly fading in as the user scrolls down the page, creating a continuous and immersive visual flow.
The header navigation, featuring 'Resident' and 'Menu', remains fixed and transparent at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll, ensuring persistent brand presence and access.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width visual modules, each typically featuring a large image or video, sometimes with a subtle blur or overlay, paired with a concise textual identifier.

technique_notes: A full-bleed video or high-resolution image serves as the initial hero, which scrolls out of view to reveal subsequent content sections.

The site employs a smooth scrolling library (like locomotive-scroll) to create a fluid, almost tactile scrolling experience, where content sections animate into view with a subtle slide-up and fade effect as they enter the viewport.
A persistent, transparent header navigation remains sticky at the top of the page, ensuring brand identity and menu access are always available without obstructing content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Small, understated sans-serif body text and labels are used throughout, with occasional very large, bold single-character display elements for emphasis.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — very generous whitespace surrounds minimal text elements and separates large image sections, contributing to a sense of openness and luxury.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its extreme minimalism, where large, full-bleed photography and video are the primary content, with text reduced to sparse, almost label-like elements. The smooth, scroll-triggered section reveals and the persistent, understated navigation create a highly refined and immersive visual journey, prioritizing atmosphere over explicit information.
